INSERT INTO accounts
             (id, username, public_key, actor_type, locked, created_at, updated_at)
           VALUES ($1, $2, '', 'Application', true, now(), now())
           ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
             SET username = EXCLUDED.username,
                 actor_type = 'Application',
                 locked = true,
                 updated_at = now()
